links_touching_record.rationale: Software requirement allocated from functional safety requirement
Integration measure verifies AFE driver SWR

The AFE driver software requirement is written against one device family's validation mechanism and DMA shape. Two drivers means two enforcement points for publish-before-use, so the requirement is a declared target of the change.

FB2-SW-IMP-000001 realises the reference project's FB2-SW-SWR-000001 at the requirement level: acquisition is triggered through AFE_StartMeasurement into the LTC sequencer, integrity is gated by LTC_CheckPec before parsed values reach the database block, and publication is the DATA_WRITE_DATA path whose database handler stamps a header timestamp. The requirement's 20 Hz, 5 ms and 100% figures are not established by this link.

FB2-SW-SWR-000001 is allocated to the reference project's FB2-SW-DSN-000001 as the software requirement whose implementation that design details. Direction is requirement -> design element, as master prompt section 13 declares for allocated_to.
Architectural element AR-001 of the technical safety concept is realised by FB2-SW-SWR-000001. The element's role and the record's statement were read against each other.

FB2-SW-SWR-000001 is the lower-level requirement allocated to the system requirement FB2-SYS-SYR-000001. The two statements and acceptance criteria were read against each other before the link was made, so the system requirement is covered indirectly through its allocation rather than directly by a measure of its own.

FB2-SW-SWR-000001 is the lower-level requirement allocated to the system requirement FB2-SYS-SYR-000002. The two statements and acceptance criteria were read against each other before the link was made, so the system requirement is covered indirectly through its allocation rather than directly by a measure of its own.

FB2-SW-SWR-000001 is the lower-level requirement allocated to the system requirement FB2-SYS-SYR-000006. The two statements and acceptance criteria were read against each other before the link was made, so the system requirement is covered indirectly through its allocation rather than directly by a measure of its own.

FB2-SW-SWR-000001 is the lower-level requirement allocated to the system requirement FB2-SYS-SYR-000007. The two statements and acceptance criteria were read against each other before the link was made, so the system requirement is covered indirectly through its allocation rather than directly by a measure of its own.

The requirement's three acceptance criteria are 50 ms acquisition period, 100% PEC rejection before database write and 25 ms database publish latency. The plan's pass criterion PC-008 states that all three must be demonstrated against a recorded result, and the specification records that the PEC criterion is covered only on a self-consistency oracle and that neither latency criterion has any oracle at all.

integrity.anchor_registry_note: The corpus provenance gate verifies each anchor against the file that anchor names and stores no registry-level digest of its own. This digest is recorded so a signature also pins which anchor set was in force.
